newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries end higher after early session woes.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries end higher after early session woes.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury market continued its two-month rally Thursday in a see-saw session that saw Treasuries decline off the bat, but recover as market participants found solace in news of low inflation and moderate economic growth.
The 30-year bond closed 13/32 higher to 101-1/32. Its yield edged down to 6.42 percent from Wednesday's 6.45 percent.

"The numbers have been favorable to the market, so people are starting to believe again," said Jim Kenney, head trader at Prudential Securities Inc. "Everytime people sell it, it goes up in their faces.
